name: v2.0.166
body:
Patch fixes:
1. Draft remix selections no longer reference the original post and instead show the actual remix.
2. Creator and Side Character accounts will now fetch results as expected
3. Improvements to fetch speed across the board
4. User created characters should now find remixes featuring that character
5. Corrupted ZIP file issue has been resolved you can download again
6. UI optimizations and better warning/status messages. 
7. Improved Queue logic
8. Fetches should feel faster in general
